tone.voice: a senior engineer writing docs — direct, complete, zero padding
tone.avoid: marketing speak, vague claims, hand-holding, over-explanation

trust_signals: GitHub stars and open source credibility
company and developer count using the tool
ux_norms: keyboard shortcuts are expected and documented
dark mode is the primary mode — always
dense layouts acceptable — users are power users
search is a primary navigation method
version and environment selectors always visible
terminal and CLI feel is a feature not a flaw

visual_language.primary_type: pure CSS — no photography, no illustration
visual_language.style: code editor aesthetic — syntax highlighting, monospace, dark theme
photography_rules: no photography anywhere in the product
marketing pages only may use abstract tech imagery
never use generic developer stock photos
visual_language.background_treatment: pure dark — editor-style background (#0d0d0d or similar). Colour only in syntax.
visual_language.empty_state_style: terminal-style message — monospace font, minimal, with actionable command
visual_language.onboarding_visual: code snippet or terminal animation — no illustration
visual_language.illustration_style: never use illustration — pure code and interface

compliance_notes: SOC2 Type II for enterprise sales
GDPR for code and data processed
